 raw=Path(path).read_bytes()
 return {'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'git_blob_sha1':hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(raw)).encode()+bytes([0])+raw).hexdigest()}
def check(path,expected):
 actual=identity(path)
 assert all(actual[k]==value for k,value in expected.items()),str(path)
 return actual
